name: Nigrescent-Dolmen
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an ancient meteor crater, patient as erosion itself.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Instruments disagree about the gravity well anomaly: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
